QuestInfo.name: [The Afterlands] The End of All Roads
QuestInfo.0: The Suspicious Sorcerer said you can hitch a ride to the afterlife with passing ghosts, as soon as you've performed his ritual 7 times.
QuestInfo.1: The Suspicious Sorcerer said you can hitch a ride to the afterlife with passing ghosts, as soon as you've performed his ritual 7 times.
QuestInfo.2: Your alleged ride to the afterlife never showed up, but you saw some things during the ritual that have left you with more questions than answers. Despite reaching a dead end, you feel as though this story is only just beginning...
